name: IfFileExists
label: If File Exists
description: Checks if a file exists or does not exist and marks the beginning of a conditional block.

fields.name: Condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Specifies whether to check if the file exists or doesn't exist.

selectOptions.label: Exists
selectOptions.description: Indicates that the file should exist.

selectOptions.label: Doesn't Exist
selectOptions.description: Indicates that the file should not exist.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the file to check.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: True if the file meets the specified condition, otherwise false.
